import ee, math, sys
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

def print_line(s):
    # Ensure only concise outputs
    print(s)

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
volcano = ee.Geometry.Point([-19.613, 63.633])  # Eyjafjallajökull
region = volcano.buffer(400000)  # 400 km radius to capture plume extent
day = '2010-05-10'
win1 = (day, '2010-05-11')                # [10, 11)
win2 = ('2010-05-09', '2010-05-12')       # widened fallback

def get_aod_composite(start, end, geom):
    terr = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD04_3K').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom)
    aqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD04_3K').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom)
    tN = terr.size().getInfo()
    aN = aqua.size().getInfo()
    return terr, aqua, tN, aN, terr.merge(aqua).select('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean')

try:
    # 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    terr, aqua, tN, aN, merged = get_aod_composite(*win1, volcano)
    print_line(f"Window: {win1[0]} to {win1[1]}")
    print_line(f"Terra MOD04_3K: {tN}  Aqua MYD04_3K: {aN}")
    if (tN + aN) == 0:
        terr, aqua, tN, aN, merged = get_aod_composite(*win2, volcano)
        print_line(f"Fallback window: {win2[0]} to {win2[1]}")
        print_line(f"Terra MOD04_3K: {tN}  Aqua MYD04_3K: {aN}")
        if (tN + aN) == 0:
            print_line("No data in both windows.")
            print("C1")
            sys.exit(0)

    # Build AOD composite (max to capture plume signal across swaths)
    aod = merged.max().rename('aod')

    # 3. Processing & Pixel counts
    # Valid AOD pixels
    valid_count = aod.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=region,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9,
    ).get('aod').getInfo()
    if (valid_count is None) or (valid_count == 0):
        print_line("No valid AOD pixels in region.")
        print("C2")
        sys.exit(0)

    # Adaptive high-AOD threshold (85th percentile)
    p85_dict = aod.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.percentile([85]),
        geometry=region,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9,
    ).getInfo()
    # Key name format: 'aod_p85'
    thr = p85_dict.get('aod_p85', None) if p85_dict else None
    if (thr is None) or (isinstance(thr, float) and (math.isnan(thr) or math.isinf(thr))):
        print_line("Percentile computation failed.")
        print("C3")
        sys.exit(0)

    ash = aod.gt(thr).rename('ash').uint8()

    # Split region into north/south halves
    lat0 = volcano.coordinates().get(1).getInfo()
    north_half = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, lat0, 180, 90]).intersection(region, 1)
    south_half = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -90, 180, lat0]).intersection(region, 1)

    # Counts of “ash” pixels
    total_ash = ash.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=region,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9,
    ).get('ash').getInfo()
    north_ash = ash.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=north_half,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9,
    ).get('ash').getInfo()
    south_ash = ash.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=south_half,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9,
    ).get('ash').getInfo()

    # Handle None cases gracefully as zeros
    total_ash = 0 if total_ash is None else int(total_ash)
    north_ash = 0 if north_ash is None else int(north_ash)
    south_ash = 0 if south_ash is None else int(south_ash)

    if total_ash == 0:
        print_line(f"Valid AOD px: {valid_count}, but no high-AOD (ash) pixels detected.")
        print("C2")
        sys.exit(0)

    north_share = (north_ash / total_ash) if total_ash > 0 else 0.0

    # 4. Evidence prints (concise)
    print_line(f"Valid AOD px: {valid_count}, AOD p85: {thr:.3f}")
    print_line(f"Ash px (total): {total_ash}")
    print_line(f"Ash px North: {north_ash}, South: {south_ash}, North share: {north_share:.2f}")

    # 5. Final Answer
    if north_ash > south_ash:
        print("A")
    else:
        print("B")

except ee.EEException as e:
    print_line("GEE Error.")
    print("D")
except Exception as e:
    print_line("Processing Error.")
    print("D")

import ee, math, sys

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
volcano = ee.Geometry.Point([-19.613, 63.633])  # Eyjafjallajökull
region = volcano.buffer(400000)  # 400 km radius
win1 = ('2010-05-10', '2010-05-11')
win2 = ('2010-05-09', '2010-05-12')

def get_col(start, end, geom):
    terr = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD04_3K')
            .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom)
            .select(['Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean'], ['aod']))
    aqua = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD04_3K')
            .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom)
            .select(['Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean'], ['aod']))
    return terr, aqua, terr.merge(aqua)

try:
    # 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    terr, aqua, merged = get_col(*win1, volcano)
    tN = terr.size().getInfo(); aN = aqua.size().getInfo()
    p(f"Window: {win1[0]} to {win1[1]}")
    p(f"Terra MOD04_3K: {tN}  Aqua MYD04_3K: {aN}")
    if (tN + aN) == 0:
        terr, aqua, merged = get_col(*win2, volcano)
        tN = terr.size().getInfo(); aN = aqua.size().getInfo()
        p(f"Fallback window: {win2[0]} to {win2[1]}")
        p(f"Terra MOD04_3K: {tN}  Aqua MYD04_3K: {aN}")
        if (tN + aN) == 0:
            p("No data in both windows.")
            print("C1"); sys.exit(0)

    # 3. Composite and Valid Pixels
    aod = merged.max().updateMask(merged.max().lt(5)).rename('aod')
    valid_count = aod.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=region, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9, bestEffort=True
    ).get('aod').getInfo()
    if (valid_count is None) or (valid_count == 0):
        p("No valid AOD pixels in region.")
        print("C2"); sys.exit(0)

    # 4. Threshold and ash mask
    p85 = aod.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.percentile([85]),
        geometry=region, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9, bestEffort=True
    ).get('aod_p85').getInfo()
    if (p85 is None) or (isinstance(p85, float) and (math.isnan(p85) or math.isinf(p85))):
        p("Percentile computation failed.")
        print("C3"); sys.exit(0)

    ash = aod.gt(p85).selfMask().rename('ash').uint8()

    # 5. North/South halves
    lat0 = volcano.coordinates().get(1).getInfo()
    north_half = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, lat0, 180, 90]).intersection(region, 1)
    south_half = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -90, 180, lat0]).intersection(region, 1)

    total_ash = ash.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=region, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9, bestEffort=True
    ).get('ash').getInfo()
    north_ash = ash.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=north_half, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9, bestEffort=True
    ).get('ash').getInfo()
    south_ash = ash.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=south_half, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9, bestEffort=True
    ).get('ash').getInfo()

    total_ash = 0 if total_ash is None else int(total_ash)
    north_ash = 0 if north_ash is None else int(north_ash)
    south_ash = 0 if south_ash is None else int(south_ash)

    # 6. Evidence prints
    p(f"Valid AOD px: {int(valid_count)}, AOD p85: {float(p85):.3f}")
    p(f"Ash px (total): {total_ash}")
    p(f"Ash px North: {north_ash}, South: {south_ash}, North share: {(north_ash/total_ash):.2f}" if total_ash>0 else "Ash px North: 0, South: 0, North share: n/a")

    decision = None
    if total_ash > 0:
        decision = 'A' if north_ash > south_ash else 'B'
    else:
        # Fallback to mean AOD comparison
        meanN = aod.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=north_half, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9, bestEffort=True
        ).get('aod').getInfo()
        meanS = aod.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=south_half, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9, bestEffort=True
        ).get('aod').getInfo()
        if (meanN is None) or (meanS is None) or any([math.isnan(float(meanN)), math.isnan(float(meanS))]):
            p("Mean AOD comparison failed.")
            print("C3"); sys.exit(0)
        p(f"Fallback mean AOD North: {float(meanN):.3f}, South: {float(meanS):.3f}")
        decision = 'A' if float(meanN) > float(meanS) else 'B'

    print(decision)

except ee.EEException:
    p("GEE Error.")
    print("D")
except Exception:
    p("Processing Error.")
    print("D")
